metaTitle: Character Counter for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and X | ReelFlow Toolkit
description: Count YouTube titles and descriptions, TikTok and Instagram captions, and X posts against their limits. Emoji-aware counts plus a unique hashtag list.
ogTitle: Character Counter for Creators - YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and X
ogDescription: Live title and caption limits with emoji-aware counting and a unique hashtag list.
ldDescription: Count title and caption characters against YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and X limits, with a unique hashtag list.
lede: Write the title and caption once, then see the same text against the limits of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and X - with a clean hashtag list.

faq.a: YouTube title 100, YouTube description 5000, TikTok caption 2200, Instagram caption 2200 and X post 280 characters. The title field feeds the YouTube title meter; the caption field feeds the rest.
Counts use whole characters (grapheme clusters), so a family emoji or a flag counts as one character instead of many code units.

faq.q: Do hashtags count in the caption?
faq.a: Yes. Hashtags are part of the caption count. The tool also lists every unique hashtag so you can copy the set without duplicates.
